scripts.build:android: export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../locked.apk && echo '✓ APK created: locked.apk' && ls -lh ../locked.apk && adb devices 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'device$' && echo '→ Device connected. Run: npm run install:android' || echo '→ No device. Copy locked.apk to phone or: adb install -r locked.apk'
scripts.install:android: adb install -r locked.apk && adb shell pm grant com.yagyaraj.locked android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS && echo '✓ Installed + WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS granted. Launch app and grant permissions:' && echo '  1. Accessibility: Settings > Accessibility > Locked > On (re-grant if you had it before — config changed)' && echo '  2. Display over other apps: allow' && echo '  3. Add apps to block'
